description: Returns the teams a named club fields this year, and which of them plays next. Call it whenever someone asks about a whole club by name, before you narrow the question to a single team. For how the club is doing, call query_club, which reads the club's page. Pass any league words the person used in `qualifier`, such as 'combo', 'mixed', 'womens', '40 & over' or '3.5', because dropping them answers a different question.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

qualifier.description: Any league words the asker used alongside the club — 'combo', 'mixed', 'womens', '40 and over', '3.5'. Omit only when they named the club alone.

name: query_club_teams
title: A club's teams this year
